spacing.$description: Base unit for Tailwind's spacing scale: p-1 = 0.25rem, p-4 = 1rem, ...

rule.$description: Divider lines in lists and timelines

logo-header.$description: Header logo: two lines of the h3 step it sits in, so it scales with that type

count.$description: Count-up numbers: long enough to read as counting, short of the 1s ceiling

stagger.$description: Delay between siblings in a scroll reveal

celebrate.$description: First-visit intro only: the extra pause after the backdrop before the card pops, with confetti

confetti.$description: First-visit confetti: one burst that falls and fades out, then is removed

overshoot.$description: Pop-out entrances: grows slightly past full size, then settles

overlay.$description: Backdrop blur behind a modal dialog
